shortDescription: New Zealand’s two main parties launched their election campaigns on Sunday, with Christopher Luxon’s National and Chris Hipkins’ Labour both pledging to restore the idea that hard-working New Zealanders should be able to get ahead, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | New Zealand’s National and Labour Launch Election Campaigns
